[One or two sentences on the hardest part, and how you solved it.]

Players verify through /verifypanel by picking a game and filling in their in-game name. Staff add teams with /teams and the bot links the bracket to Challonge, then reports match results back to it. Players, teams and rosters live in MySQL.
